exact: cis-Golgi-derived vesicle fusion with medial-Golgi cisterna membrane

definition: The joining of the lipid bilayer membrane around a cis-Golgi-derived vesicle to the lipid bilayer membrane around the medial-Golgi cisterna. Vesicles are involved in anterograde transport.
label: cis-Golgi-derived vesicle fusion with Golgi medial cisterna membrane
